incident-bot: INCIDENT 1862345600 created — sev2 — auto-pager triggered: kv-batcher latency/error spike. Pager routed to anna (oncall).

anna (oncall): seeing 95p token latency jump and a burst of 5xx on tool-invoke routes. Dashboard: /dash/kv-batcher -> latency up 3x, error-rate up ~5%.

anna (oncall): root symptoms: continuous-batching threads are breaking when structured tool outputs appear to include large schema markers. Batcher logs show repeated 'batch_break:structured_marker' and massive kv_cache evictions.

mike (eng-runtime): digging in logs now. grep output: ``
[batcher] batch_id=0x7f3e error=batch_break reason=STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_MARKER size=1123
[kv_cache] eviction_count=12423 miss_rate=0.67
[kv_cache] active_keys=1,238,912
``

mike (eng-runtime): hypothesis: function-calling responses with structured output (complex nested json + long tool-call metadata) are exceeding batching prefix heuristics, fragmenting batches and flushing KV entries, which explodes cache churn + memory pressure -> cascading misses and higher latency.

anna (oncall): customer impact? jim?

jim (se): AtlasPay reports 15% of user flows triggering toolcall returning error. Error pattern = 502s from service layer when batch worker times out. Other customers on toolcall-heavy routes show 3-8% elevated errors.

sara (product): flagged high-priority for customers with heavy funcall/structured-output. We should avoid broad customer comms until mitigation. We'll prepare a targeted note for AtlasPay.

anna (oncall): initial mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_batch_size to 8 for affected model tags; 2) disable continuous batching for routes with tool/function calls; 3) route high-risk traffic to fallback model variant without structured outputs; 4) scale batcher pool +3.

mike (eng-runtime): I can patch runtime config. Proposed config patch: ``
PATCH /internal/batcher/config
{
  "match": {"route_tags": ["funcall", "toolcall"]},
  "settings": {"max_batch_size": 8, "continuous_batching": false, "kv_cache_ttl_seconds": 30}
``
Applying now.

deploy-bot: queued deployment 98423 for service=redwood-batcher config=batcher-config-hotfix. CI passed.

infra-bot: scaling redwood-batcher pool: desired +3 replicas -> scheduling.

deploy-bot: deployment 98423 rolled out to canary (2 nodes). Monitoring canary.

mike (eng-runtime): canary metrics look good — no batch_break logs on canary. Rolling to 30% traffic over next 5m.

anna (oncall): throttling toolcall routes at edge for protective measure: ``
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/route-throttle -d 'route=toolcall&rate=0.9'
``

ops-bot: throttle applied to route=toolcall -> 0.9 (10% drop to fallback).

anna (oncall): monitoring KV miss rate and 95p latency.

~6m later~

mike (eng-runtime): canary stable. After full rollout, kv_cache eviction rate fell to baseline, 95p latency back to ~1.1x. Error rates on toolcall routes dropping.

infra-bot: batcher pool scaled to +3 as requested. No OOMs observed on new instances.

anna (oncall): customer impact update: AtlasPay errors reduced to baseline after routing fallback + throttle. Other customers trending down.

jim (se): we're engaging AtlasPay SE to confirm and coordinate a post-incident review.

sara (product): drafting targeted customer note for AtlasPay and customers on funcall->toolcall routes. Will hold until postmortem draft.

anna (oncall): handoff: switching to monitoring, handing to devon (next-oncall) for overnight watch and postmortem lead. Key actions for follow-up:
- root cause analysis: why structured output markers cause batch fragmentation and KV churn;
- add unit/integration tests to ensure structured outputs are batch-friendly;
- improve batcher heuristics to avoid evicting on large single-response markers;
- add an early warning alert for kv_cache_eviction_rate > X and batch_break rate.

devon (next-oncall): ack — I'll pick this up. Current status: mitigations deployed (config patch + throttle + scaling). I'll keep an eye on dashboards (KV cache miss, batch_break logs, per-route error rate).

anna (oncall): timeline notes for postmortem: incident created 1862345600, mitigations applied 1862345675 (config patch), full rollout 1862345710, stable -> monitoring 1862345760.

ops-bot: incident 1862345600 marked as MONITORING by anna (oncall).

devon (next-oncall): added follow-ups in: #pm-triage and assigned to mike/jim/sara for RCA + customer comms. I'll own the postmortem draft.

sara (product): agreed. Also propose we add 'structured-output' tag validation in model onboarding checklist.

anna (oncall): thanks everyone. If anything flares, re-pager. Otherwise we'll capture action items in the postmortem and close after RCA and customer outreach. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 1862345600 transitioned to MONITORING.
